sections.heading: WHAT GOES HERE
sections.body: This file is written by the weekly-summary managed agent — it clones nothing, it just calls the GitHub MCP `create_or_update_file` tool against this exact path (content/weekly-summaries/latest.json) every week. Once it runs, this placeholder gets overwritten with real league banter.
